name: PolicyHelix
title: Make every decision inspectable.
description: A private web workspace for authorization policies, simulation results and controlled rollout.
invariants: Only authenticated normalized identity enters policy
Bundle signature plus freshness and monotonic revision

tasks.title: docs(product): freeze the open-source clone-to-value workflow
acceptance: Define one repository-owned synthetic reference workflow, expected results and failure cases. No customer interview, paid account, external pilot count or market-validation claim is required.

tasks.title: chore(toolchain): lock reproducible open-source resources
acceptance: Record exact supported runtime, engine, provider/image, grammar, rule and fixture versions/digests, licenses and official release sources. Use real dependency lockfiles and preserve a source-build route.

tasks.title: feat(runtime): implement unified local engine setup and launch
acceptance: npm run setup prepares the actual selected local engine and npm start supervises the web workspace and loopback engine with clean shutdown. Minimal health does not imply completed business features; no second undocumented terminal is required.

tasks.title: feat(contracts): define typed versioned domain inputs and results
acceptance: Implement exact typed domain inputs, output/error codes, size/time/cancellation limits and positive/negative compatibility fixtures. Generic nested JSON is not a domain contract. No database schema change is allowed.

tasks.title: feat(storage): prove recoverable local authoritative writes
acceptance: Use ADR-0003 storage ports, a bounded single writer, atomic visible state, stable operation IDs and tested interrupted/disk-full/replay recovery. No database schema, migration, .env or Dockerfile changes.

tasks.title: ci(engine): verify the actual engine from a clean checkout
acceptance: Build and test the actual selected engine, typed contracts and storage using pinned local open-source providers where relevant. Add exact engine test commands and collect the listed test directories. Shell-only tests cannot verify an engine.

tasks.title: feat(policy): model input output and resource classes
acceptance: Public routes are explicit configuration and all unspecified routes default private.

tasks.title: feat(opa): evaluate bounded local policy bundles
acceptance: Invalid policy and deadline produce deny/error; no silent fallback permit.

tasks.title: feat(simulator): run expected decision fixtures offline
acceptance: CLI reports changed allow/deny decisions with reasons and policy digest.

tasks.title: feat(bundles): build deterministic signed policy bundle
acceptance: Bundle records issuer, digest, revision and validity period.

tasks.title: feat(verification): require bundle trust and freshness
acceptance: Missing signature, wrong key, stale revision and expired validity are rejected.

tasks.title: feat(activation): atomically persist and switch active policy
acceptance: Crash during switch retains valid previous bundle and highest accepted revision.

tasks.title: feat(oidc): validate login state nonce and tokens
acceptance: Wrong issuer/audience, nonce replay, invalid callback state and expired token fail.

tasks.title: feat(sessions): persist revocable server side sessions
acceptance: Session stores fingerprints and safe server-held credentials; cookie rotation prevents fixation.

tasks.title: feat(revoke): enforce bounded stale authorization window
acceptance: Revoked session stops within configured 30-second bound under target workload.

tasks.title: feat(identity): normalize trusted subject context
acceptance: Client identity headers are stripped before trusted values are constructed.

tasks.title: feat(gateway): protect one allowlisted upstream
acceptance: Arbitrary upstream URLs cannot be selected; origin is reachable only by gateway.

tasks.title: feat(obligations): enforce supported policy obligations
acceptance: Unknown mandatory obligation denies rather than being ignored.

tasks.title: feat(failures): implement per resource outage behavior
acceptance: Decision loss denies sensitive routes; public route bypass remains intentional and testable.

tasks.title: feat(audit): log decision metadata without tokens
acceptance: Decision includes subject pseudonym, policy and outcome without bearer token or cookie.

tasks.title: feat(ui): render policy simulator and decision diffs
acceptance: UI displays policy revision and explains changed decision using fixture context.

tasks.title: feat(ui): expose gateway health and session revoke
acceptance: Operator sees stale policy, IdP outage and revocation result without exposing tokens.

tasks.title: feat(rollout): test candidate policies in shadow mode
acceptance: Shadow decision never changes enforced result and divergence is auditable.

tasks.title: feat(caches): bound policy decision cache keys and expiry
acceptance: Subject/action/context/revision all bind cache; revoke invalidates stale decisions.

tasks.title: feat(rotation): rotate trust keys without rollback gap
acceptance: New trust set is operator-controlled; removed key cannot activate an old signed bundle.

tasks.title: test(enforcement): verify origin bypass outage and replay
acceptance: Direct origin, forged header, revoked session, expired bundle and policy outage all fail as specified.

tasks.title: test(security): prove project abuse and authorization boundaries
acceptance: Execute this project's negative UAT, XSS/import and object/provider authorization tests for every enabled surface. Fix critical/high findings or block the affected supported profile.

tasks.title: perf(local): measure bounded target and overload workloads
acceptance: Record hardware, OS, source and fixture identities, latency/CPU/RSS/disk, cancellation and saturation for the target and an over-limit workload. Publish only observed limits and reduce unsupported targets.

tasks.title: feat(operations): expose real engine readiness and redacted diagnostics
acceptance: Separate web health from engine, authoritative storage and required provider readiness. Failures are visible; logs are bounded and exclude synthetic secret/credential sentinels.

tasks.title: test(acceptance): prove full local usability from git clone
acceptance: On a clean supported Linux host, git clone -> npm run setup -> npm start completes this project's full reference workflow, negative cases, restart and restore with verified C01-C30 evidence. This is the first locally usable supported product.

tasks.title: build(release): package complete reproducible open-source artifacts
acceptance: Package the actual engine, web UI and offline rules/resources, source archive/build recipes, SBOM, upstream notices, checksums and provenance. A web-only artifact cannot satisfy this complete-product task.

tasks.title: feat(network): harden local launch and optional private hosting
acceptance: Local operation needs no owned public domain. Prove loopback/origin/cache boundaries and document optional TLS/private ingress without exposing engine work by default.

tasks.title: test(ux): verify keyboard mobile failures and compatible updates
acceptance: Complete the actual reference workflow with keyboard/table equivalents at 360px and 1440px, invalid/empty/interrupted/provider-outage cases and N-1 data/export fixtures. Advertise only observed supported platforms.

tasks.title: docs(oss): complete installation usage contribution and support guides
acceptance: A fresh reader completes the core task from public instructions. Document source builds, licenses, data/limits/privacy/recovery/support and a confirmed vulnerability reporting route without mandatory cloud or paid entitlements.

tasks.title: test(distribution): verify signed artifacts and data-safe upgrades
acceptance: Verify integrity and authenticity against independently trusted release identity/key. Install, upgrade and roll back on supported hosts without discarding newer accepted data; maintain the documented source-build alternative.

tasks.title: test(onboarding): repeat clone-to-value independently
acceptance: A separate clean environment or independent contributor follows only the public guide and completes the actual core workflow. Record observed effort and failures; customer demand and five pilots are not prerequisites for OSS usability.

tasks.title: fix(acceptance): resolve observed installation and workflow blockers
acceptance: Fix actual C30/C33/C35/C36 failures with targeted regressions and repeat affected checks. Keep unresolved blockers explicit; never invent feedback or weaken an invariant to claim completion.

tasks.title: docs(release): freeze local privacy limits and maintenance policy
acceptance: Document local data locations, export/deletion/retention/backup/recovery, supported profiles and maintenance/dependency policy. No required hosted subscription, paid core feature or unearned SLA.

tasks.title: ci(release): enforce evidence-backed open-source v1 readiness
acceptance: Verify actual evidence for C01-C38, full clone-to-value, complete source/engine packaging, dependency/fixture licenses and supported-profile security/recovery. Planning templates, missing proofs and wrong-source evidence fail the release gate.

tasks.title: chore(release): publish and install the verified open-source v1
acceptance: Use a maintainer-authorized publication workflow to publish the verified source/tag and full artifacts. Install the actual published version on a clean host and complete the same core task; retain real source/version, results and rollback evidence.

webTasks.title: Browser workspace and project roadmap
webTasks.acceptance: Responsive workspace, local JSON preview, accessible navigation and filterable forty-task roadmap work.

webTasks.title: Validated runtime and constrained web server
webTasks.acceptance: Configuration fails closed; no engine admission, same-origin paths, health scopes, no-store configuration and path containment are tested.

webTasks.title: Automated build and verification pipeline
webTasks.acceptance: Pinned Actions build the application, run web tests and publish a web-only CI artifact. Remote run result is recorded separately.

webTasks.title: Web release packaging and operator configuration
webTasks.acceptance: Package contains runnable web server, assets, checksums and provenance; TLS proxy and hardened systemd templates are supplied, not deployed.

webTasks.title: Reconcile web delivery with product plans
webTasks.acceptance: All supplied forty product intents and requirements remain traceable. Existing code and protected configuration are preserved.

webTasks.title: PolicyHelix engine integration
webTasks.acceptance: Implement the first domain slice from IMPLEMENTATION_BLUEPRINT.md through the browser; return real typed results and failures.

webTasks.title: Private identity and permission boundaries
webTasks.acceptance: Establish project-scoped identity, object authorization, CSRF for cookie mutations, bounded work and redacted audit before enabling a private engine API.

webTasks.title: Observed host deployment and recovery
webTasks.acceptance: Provision an owned domain/TLS and approved private admission, install artifact, observe health, validate persistence/provider recovery and retain measured evidence.
